Karnataka CM Orders Probe into Dalit Ministers' Dasara Entry Denial

Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah has ordered an investigation after three Dalit ministers were reportedly stopped from entering the Mysuru Dasara venue. The incident occurred during the Mysuru Dasara celebrations. The Chief Minister's directive followed the denial of entry to the ministers.
